stories.title: Define Brand Audit Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a structured schema for brand audit results including artifact path, artifact type (code, UI, document), detected name variants, compliance status, and normalized replacement value enforcing 'ChatHealthy.ai'. Ensure compatibility with manifest_generator outputs and GPTReader file access patterns.

stories.title: Implement Brand Name Detection and Audit Logic
stories.description: Implement scanning logic leveraging the project manifest to iterate all artifacts and detect non-compliant variants (e.g., 'ChatHealthy', casing issues, spacing). Include regex + rule-based normalization aligned to required canonical name 'ChatHealthy.ai' and support batch processing across manifest entries.

stories.title: Expose Brand Audit Results via API and Report UI
stories.description: Expose audit results via a FastAPI endpoint and render a simple admin-facing report (or JSON output) showing violations, file locations, and suggested corrections. Align output with existing debug_logger and reporting patterns used in backend services.

stories.title: Brand Audit Test Suite (Unit + Integration)
stories.description: Create unit tests for detection rules and integration tests that run against a subset of real project artifacts (frontend, backend, Website) using manifest-driven inputs to validate end-to-end audit accuracy and minimize false positives.

stories.title: Integrate Brand Audit into Dev Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate the brand audit into the dev pipeline using existing DevOps tooling (dev_pipeline, manifest_generator, and promote_build) so audits run automatically and block or flag violations prior to build promotion across dev→qa→prod.
